product.title: UTV Tour Puerto Vallarta

description.text: In Puerto Vallarta, this guided UTV day leaves the resort strip for Sierra Madre mountain tracks in a Polaris RZR. After a safety briefing and driving lesson, the group follows rainforest trails and stream crossings to a natural swimming pool for a hike, swim, and included snacks. Hotel pickup and drop-off keep the outing on the jungle route rather than rental counters or self-navigation. Helmets, goggles, and a professional guide are included so visitors can focus on the terrain instead of vehicle logistics. The format suits visitors who want a guided off-road day without booking a UTV independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Puerto Vallarta, and the itinerary stays on Sierra Madre trails and the swim-hole stop that define this rainforest UTV tour.

highlights: Go on a thrilling rainforest adventure in an UTV (utility terrain vehicle)
Escape the city and barrel through streams and down remote jungle paths
Learn how to maneuver a Polaris RZR UTV from an experienced instructor
Enjoy relaxing hike, a dip at a remote swim-hole, and complimentary snacks

start.description: Hotel pickup is included from listed Puerto Vallarta hotels. Confirm the pickup window when booking.

end.description: Return to your Puerto Vallarta meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
